context.passage:
B*E-mail*
To:
All Staff
From:
Jason Saylor
Subject:
Company envelopes
Date:
April 12
Dear Team,
Unfortunately, we have run out of Leewood Associates printed envelopes. Until the next
batch arrives with our regular office supply order on April 15, please use Leewood
Associates return-address labels for any outgoing mail. For brochures about new home
listings or our professional property management services, there is no need to include
any return address as our current contact information is already printed on all of our
promotional materials.
When using return-address labels, please remember to check them carefully since we
moved oflices only two months ago and some of them still include our former address.
All the best.
Jason Saylor
Executive Assistant

choices: A business will move to a new location.
A marketing brochure will be printed.
items.question: According to the e-mail, what will happen on April 15?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：篇章中可定位到“batch arrives with our regular office supply order on April 15, please use Leewood”。选择理由：该项复现或同义改写了定位信息，其他选项与原文细节不一致。正确答案：B（A shipment will arrive.）。
